claim: Exampleton's Harbour Bridge reopened to traffic in March 2026.

evidence.quote: The Harbour Bridge will stay closed to all vehicles until repairs are finished in November 2026.
evidence.context: Pedestrian access remains open on the north walkway. The Harbour Bridge will stay closed to all vehicles until repairs are finished in November 2026. Detours are signposted.

evidence.quote: the bridge, closed since January, has not reopened to cars and is not expected to before the winter
evidence.context: Council engineers said steel deliveries were late. Officials confirmed that the bridge, closed since January, has not reopened to cars and is not expected to before the winter.

evidence.quote: a post claiming the Harbour Bridge reopened in March has been shared thousands of times
evidence.context: Local groups are discussing the closure. This week a post claiming the Harbour Bridge reopened in March has been shared thousands of times.
